snippet.title: FreeSO Launch Trailer (game has been shut down, read description)
snippet.description: EDIT: Hello. FreeSO was shut down as of 9-December-2024. It was a great ride, but unfortunately, it is now over. These videos will stay up for those interested in them, and there were a few other The Sims Online private servers out there in which you can make use of these videos. I have personally been trying a brand new game like FreeSO called Vitare and enjoying it. I also will be uploading lots of videos of plenty of other things. I do hope you all had a wonderful time in FreeSO like I did, and happy Simming! I wanted to make a FreeSO video, but I didn't expect this. Enjoy!
